description: An unofficial, typed .NET client for the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint REST API (v1.0): vulnerabilities, software, alerts, machines, machine actions, indicators, advanced hunting and exports. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.

Test kit for MCP servers built with the official ModelContextProtocol C# SDK: an in-memory host, assertions for tools, prompts and resources, tool-surface snapshots with breaking-change detection, and lint rules for tool descriptions and parameter names.
mcpprobe: a CLI that connects to any MCP server over stdio or HTTP and checks its tool surface against a committed snapshot (breaking-change detection) and lint rules. Built for CI.

The platform's biometric prompt for .NET MAUI, without Spine's core: IBiometricAuth asks for Face ID, Touch ID or Optic ID, Android's fingerprint or face, or Windows Hello, with the device passcode to fall back on.
Helper library providing marshalers and stubs for GeneratedComInterface pipeline
Imports the COM interfaces from an IDL file for use with .NET. Can handle c-style arrays and OLECHAR pointers.

Zero-alloc OpenType text shaping and SDF layout engine for F#. Targets Wasm-GC backends. Parses cmap/hmtx/kern/GPOS, shapes Latin text, flows glyphs into arbitrary SDF shapes (Circle, Diamond, Triangle, Parallelogram), and emits a WebGPU-ready DrawList.
What a dashboard or SCADA screen needs that is not drawing: samples with quality, the ISA-18.2 alarm state machine and the compression of a history by deadband. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
Tables of facts summed along hierarchies: cubes of prefix sums, pivoting, drill-down, formulas over measures and the formatting of amounts. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
The look of the platform as data: colour ramps, light and dark roles, scales of space, type, radius and motion, the contrast the roles keep, and the exports to CSS custom properties and JSON.
Processes the way Erlang/OTP has them, as pure state machines: supervisors with restart strategies and a pool of workers with at-least-once delivery. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.

An incremental data graph: an engine that runs calcs again only when something they read changed, and a document of versioned, invertible patches with a history. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
The edits of a document as data: operations that can be undone, where a drop lands, a history, an edit in place. No geometry, no rendering; runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
JSON, number parsing: a value type, a writer, a parser that reports the position of the first problem. No dependencies; runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
Typed CSS and HTML for the web and for email: colour, style, a document tree, an inliner and the grid and components of Foundation for Emails. No dependencies; runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
The operations of a table as incremental calcs of the graph engine: filter, group by, pivot, plans over a cube, fold. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
The formulas of a spreadsheet: a parser with positions, an evaluator with spreadsheet errors, and a sheet whose cells are calcs of the FSharp.Wasm.Graph engine. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
F# base library (System.* surface, Option, Result, collections, math helpers, host-interop attributes) for programs compiled by fsharp-wasm to WebAssembly GC.
Icons as typed shapes on a 24 x 24 grid (the Lucide set), drawn the same everywhere: SVG markup, DOM elements, canvas paths. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
Envío de mails por SMTP.
The render pipeline: diffing of scenes, cached nodes and the protocol that carries a frame to a renderer. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
Vectors, rectangles, 2D and 3D matrices, Bezier curves and colour: the geometry the scene graph computes with. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
The icons of FSharp.Wasm.Icons (Lucide) drawn on a canvas: SVG path data flattened into round-ended strokes in the scene graph. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
Builders and operators that write a scene as F# expressions, with an optimiser pass. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
The Elmish architecture (model, update, view, commands) for scene-graph programs. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
Widgets drawn by the scene graph: theme, controls, property widgets, tabs and a grid, with keyboard and accessibility semantics. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
Signed-distance-field shapes, a shape cache and the draw list that renderers consume. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
The canvas host: a resolved scene drawn onto one HTML canvas through the runtime's imports, with damage tracking. For programs compiled by fsharp-wasm.
Charts drawn by the scene graph with data structures that make a frame cost the pixels, not the points: min/max pyramids and summed-area tables. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
Where a drag lands: drop slots, drag sessions, the same drag by keyboard and edge scrolling; pure geometry shared by canvas and DOM editors. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
The scene graph: animation, layout, resolution to absolute geometry, picking (hit testing) and routing, and the semantic tree for accessibility. Runs under .NET and as WebAssembly GC.
